edits.say: With the power still on, hold the yellow tester near the wires in the blue box and watch it glow red. That proves the tester works. Flip the breaker for this circuit to OFF, then hold the tester to every wire again. It must stay dark.
placements: yellow-black Sperry tester tip → against the wires inside the blue wall box with power ON, glowing red (proves the tester works); fingers on the handle only
black breaker handle in gray panel → OFF (the video doesn't show the breaker number; it's in the left column, lower middle)
yellow-black tester tip → against every wire in the blue box again, staying dark

missing_after: 0:38-1:04: pull all the wires out of the box and spread them apart, then identify them: two bare copper grounds, two white neutrals, two black hots (on-screen labels at 0:54-1:02).
why: 0:22-0:28 tester glows red in the live box; 0:32 'OFF' at the panel; 0:34-0:36 retest stays dark. The live-first test proves the tester works, and the plan leaves it out.

edits.safety: Keep the breaker OFF while your hands are in the box.

why: 0:38-1:04 is pulling out and labelling the wires; the ground twisting starts at 1:08 (pliers at the box 1:10-1:20) and the remaining end is bent into a hook at 1:26-1:28. The 'sharp enough to stab you' line overstates the risk.

edits.instruction: Turn the power back on briefly to find the live LINE wire, then switch it off again.
edits.say: Flip the same breaker back to ON. Hold the yellow tester near the lower black wire. It glows, so that's LINE. The upper black wire stays dark, so that's LOAD. Flip the breaker back OFF and check that the tester stays dark.
placements: same black breaker handle in gray panel → ON (the video doesn't show the number; use the same handle as before)
yellow-black tester tip → near the end of the lower black wire (comes out of the bottom of the box): glows red = LINE, from the power source
yellow-black tester tip → near the upper black wire (comes out of the top left of the box): stays dark = LOAD, goes to the light
same black breaker handle → back to OFF before touching any wire

why: 1:30-1:32 breaker ON; 1:38-1:42 the tester glows on the lower black wire ('LINE from power source'); 1:44-1:46 the upper-left black wire is 'LOAD goes to the light fixture'; 1:50 'OFF' at the panel. The plan leaves out switching the breaker back off.
1:54-1:58 pliers strip the white wires; 2:00-2:08 they're twisted together; 2:10-2:14 a beige/red wire nut is screwed on; 2:16-2:18 it's pushed into the box.

edits.safety: Keep the breaker OFF while you strip and bend the wires.

why: 2:20-2:24 labels: LOAD upper-left black, LINE bottom black, ground hook; 2:26-2:38 the black ends are stripped and hooked with pliers and the blue-handled stripper; 2:40-2:42 there are three J-hooks. The timing and directions are right; the safety line overstated pinching.

placements: bare copper hook (middle wire from blue box) → clockwise around the green ground screw on the metal yoke at the top-left end of the switch, tightened with the orange-handled screwdriver
lower black LINE hook (from bottom of blue box) → clockwise around the bottom brass terminal screw on the right (yellow) side of the switch, tightened with screwdriver
upper black LOAD hook (from upper left of blue box) → clockwise around the top brass terminal screw on the right (yellow) side of the switch, tightened with screwdriver

missing_after: 3:28-3:50: the video sets the switch over the box, turns the breaker ON (3:32), flips the toggle to test, then turns the breaker OFF again (3:48-3:50). If you keep this, touch only the toggle while it's live; it's safer to skip it and test at the end.
why: 2:48-3:02 ground to the green yoke screw (top-left when upright, 0:02/3:28); 3:10-3:14 bottom black to the bottom brass screw; 3:16-3:22 upper black to the top brass screw. The green screw is on the yoke end, not a 'metal side'.

edits.safety: The breaker was just back on. Make sure it's OFF again and the tester stays dark before you push the switch into the box.

why: 3:28-3:46 is a live toggle test with the switch hanging out (breaker ON at 3:32); 3:48-3:50 'OFF'; the switch is pushed in and the yoke screws are driven with a drill at 3:52-4:02. The planned 207 s start covers the live test.
4:04 plate fitted; 4:06-4:08 plate screws with a screwdriver; 4:12 breaker 'ON'; 4:16 toggle flipped; 4:24-4:30 ceiling light on.
